Tour overview

Day-by-day itinerary

  1. Day 1Pinnawala

    Meet your driver at the airport, visit Pinnawala and see Meeyan Ella waterfall.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  2. Day 2Sigiriya

    Join a village cooking experience and climb Lion Rock for sunset.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  3. Day 3Kandy

    Catch sunrise at Pidurangala, visit Dambulla and continue to Kandy for the Temple of the Tooth.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  4. Day 4Ella

    Explore Kandy before taking the train to Ella, subject to seat availability.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  5. Day 5Ella to Mirissa

    Visit Little Adam’s Peak and Ravana Falls before heading to the coast.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  6. Day 6Mirissa

    Spend the day snorkelling and relaxing, with a private candlelit beach dinner.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  7. Day 7Colombo and departure

    Visit a turtle hatchery and stop in Colombo before the airport transfer.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
